issues.desc: background.md Solution Tradeoffs references "3x2 review" ("trigger a full 3x2 review") without defining the abbreviation. A standalone reader cannot infer that 3x2 means 3-reviewer × 2-host. Suggest expanding on first use or adding a parenthetical.

background.md Key Insights references "B-0985 M0/M1 + B-0405 M2-M7" without defining M0/M1/M2-M7. These milestone labels are unexpanded and a new reader cannot tell whether they are implementation phases, milestones, or something else.
